name: button
description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button. Variants: default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link. Sizes: default, sm, lg, icon.

aria: Uses native button semantics unless asChild changes the rendered element.
consumer: Keep a visible label or provide aria-label for icon-only actions.
